scope: Canonical by-Place for Akerselva as a multi-neighborhood river corridor and route with three anchors, not any one fall, mill, bridge, factory or riverside business.

external_sources.label: Oslo byleksikon — Akerselva
external_sources.use: history of river, industrial mills and place boundary

people.evidence: Both are canonical existing People with documentary association to textile industry beside Akerselva; each has a distinct, image-loaded licensed portrait. Primary place IDs remain Vøyenfossen and Glads mølle respectively.
people.preview_contract: Either person may preview, but People popup must show both; no placeholder imagery.

objects.decision: No single separately documented canonical physical object with its own member image and an appropriate ownership anchor at the entire river corridor. Apparatus and signs identified at individual mills are owned by their specific Places, not duplicated here.

brands.decision: Hjula Væverier og Vøiens Bomuldsspinderi er dokumenterte fabrikker med egne stedseiere; ingen river-wide Brand opprettes. Akerselva Miljøpark er i det undersøkte materialet et offentlig plan- og samarbeidsprosjekt, ikke en dokumentert selvstendig Brand-identitet. Et manglende logo-foto brukes ikke som eneste N/A-grunn.

structures.decision: The candidate structures or fall facilities are individually registered canonical Places. They should remain navigable via related Places/routing rather than duplicate entity cards under the full river Place.

preserve: 30 canonical fullquiz questions and source IDs
pending_vferdig: Rettslig og visuelt verifisert Før/etter-par for selve elvestrekningen.
Endelig browser-QA av navigasjon og nye kunnskapsmoduler på PR-head.
note: Artikkel, claims og kronologi er lukket i #6859. Relaterte steder materialiseres som egen navigasjon under Om; ikke som samlingsmedlemmer.
